title: scan_settings_list
description: Run-level acquisition settings, mirroring mzML scanSettingsList. Stored in the file-level metadata of the mzPeak archive (FileIndex.metadata.scan_settings_list). This is the authoritative home for run-constant imaging geometry CV params: grid size (IMS:1000042/43), pixel size (IMS:1000046/47), max physical dimensions (IMS:1000044/45, unit µm UO:0000017), absolute position offsets (IMS:1000053/54), and acquisition-geometry child terms (e.g. IMS:1000413 flyback). Only geometry the source actually declared is emitted; absent terms are omitted, never fabricated (spec Edit 3, GEO-01). NOTE: schema/param.json does not exist in this repo, so the parameters item shape is INLINED here to match how the metadata.imaging block and the reverse imzML emitter encode cvParams.

parameters.description: CV params carrying the run-constant geometry. Each item is an inlined CV-param object (param.json not present in this repo).

value.description: term value; absent for presence-only terms

targets.description: optional acquisition targets; unused by the imaging-geometry facet
